resources.string: Choose one method — you do not need both.
Open About phone. Tap Build number seven times. On Xiaomi, tap OS version instead. Enter your screen lock if asked.
See where to enable Developer options

Connect to Wi-Fi. You will enter Android’s six-digit code through Sukut’s notification. Keep the pairing-code window open, pull down notifications, expand Sukut’s notification, then tap Enter pairing code and send the code.
Tap below and allow notifications. In Android settings, enable Wireless debugging and choose Pair device with pairing code. Follow step 2; Sukut returns here when ready.
Sukut returns when ready. If you began with the power button, filtering starts too. Later, press power to use the saved pairing.
In Developer options, turn on USB debugging.
Use a USB data cable. Unlock the phone and approve Allow USB debugging for your computer.
Windows: Sukut → Phone → Activate Sukut.\nLinux: run activate-sukut.sh.\nWait for Ready on this phone.

Once ready, you can turn Wireless debugging off or unplug USB. Android keeps Sukut in Paired devices; this is saved permission, not the worker’s status. If activation is lost, enable Wireless debugging and press power to reconnect. Pair again only if Android forgot the permission.
Real phone example. Sensitive details are blurred. Your phone may look slightly different.
